overall_status: Scoped visual and keyboard-disclosure evidence is positive; not a whole-product accessibility pass.

observations.320px_readability: pass: conflict name, occupied interval, and overlap interval wrap without visible horizontal clipping.
observations.390px_readability: pass: proposal and conflict details remain legible; overlap is emphasized in bold text.
observations.non_color_cues: pass: conflict count, event name, occupied-time label, overlap label, and disclosure text communicate status without color alone.
observations.focus_evidence: partial pass: visible focus ring in the 320px disclosure screenshot; Playwright verifies Enter expands the remaining conflict.
observations.contrast: final screenshot review found the text visually distinguishable but did not measure every rendered color; source-token calculation after the fix is recorded below.
observations.fixed_navigation: The fixed navigation overlays some lower content in the captured viewport. Playwright verifies the approval button can be scrolled completely above the navigation.

source_token_contrast_calculation.method: WCAG relative-luminance contrast calculation from final Tailwind colors and mobile workspace surface overrides; not a browser-wide contrast scan.

verified_by_playwright: 320px body scroll width equals the viewport width.
Keyboard Enter expands the native disclosure and reveals the remaining event.
After scrolling, the approval button's lower edge is above the fixed mobile navigation.
not_verified: Full-product manual keyboard order and focus return.
Touch target dimensions and physical-device behavior.
Every color combination outside the measured approval labels and inactive mobile navigation.
